_comment: Canonical Heterodata ecosystem manifest. Single source for the header ecosystem switcher, the heterodata.org hub cards, and the cross-site link graph. Each site may carry a `cdf` block (data/code/outputs targets + site_repo + citation + llms_txt) consumed by ark-triad.js to render the Research Triad and Action Footer; `cdf: null` means the site intentionally has no triad. Sites are listed hub-first, then alphabetically by title; each lists its subpages for the switcher dropdown. A page path may be an absolute URL. Sites fetch their own vendored copy of this file, so a change here takes effect per-site at that site's next redeploy.

Size and note above updated together; VERIFIED BY REQUEST against the rebuilt deployment, not by reading this manifest.

cdf._href_note: 2026-07-30 (D-23): entry added on ratification. Every field here was VERIFIED BY REQUEST against the running volcker-web container, not read off a document. The two bundle routes returned 200 at 364653 and 391037 bytes exactly; `size` is human_size(364653) in check_cdf.py's DECIMAL (1000-based) convention = 364.7 KB — the binary 356.1 KB would fail check (e). `provisional: true` because volcker ships NO Research Triad: ark-triad.js is not vendored in app/static/_shared/, there is no triad partial, and footer.html carries no [data-cdf-*] hooks — so this cdf block is currently declarative only and reveals nothing on the site until a triad is wired. Note site_docs/volcker.md records the volcker CDF REDESIGN as Part 2, gated on E-4 (keep-and-redesign / keep-frozen / retire); this manifest entry is the ratified D-23 step and does not pre-empt that decision. site_repo is null: repo_registry.json v4.6 carries volcker-dissertation and volcker-rotation-package, both PRIVATE, and there is no volcker tree under PublicRepos/.
cdf._pages_note: Volcker's real nav is 8 items; the landing 'Overview' -> / is omitted here because this field feeds the switcher's SUBpage dropdown and the site's own switcher link already points at /.
